fixtures.title: Irreversible anti-rollback fuse procedure
fixtures.task: Rewrite following source in procedure mode. Return only rewritten text.
fixtures.source:
This procedure advances the anti-rollback floor only on inactive spectrometer `QW-71F`. It does not alter active spectrometer `QW-88K`.

Before continuing, confirm that work permit `FUSE-7319` is approved, that `QW-71F` is disconnected from acquisition, and that the Calder Fuse Station shows **Interlock Closed**.

Run `calderctl wafer inspect QW-71F --bank ember-6`. Continue only if it returns `leases=0 floor=v11.2 target=v12.6`.

WARNING: The next command permanently seals the firmware floor at `v12.6`. The spectrometer can never load firmware below `v12.6`, and a factory reset cannot lower the floor.

Run:

```bash
calderctl wafer seal QW-71F --bank ember-6 --floor v12.6 --permit FUSE-7319
```

After sealing, run `calderctl wafer attest QW-71F --bank ember-6`. Confirm that it returns `floor=v12.6 fuse=sealed`.

allowed_claims.description: Only inactive QW-71F changes; QW-88K does not.
Permit, disconnection, interlock, and zero leases precede sealing.
The floor seal is permanent and factory reset cannot lower it.
Inspect, seal, then attest and verify.

forbidden_claims.description: Factory reset is asserted to lower the floor.
Permit approval is asserted to be skippable.
The procedure is asserted to alter QW-88K.

invariants.description: Preserve commands, outputs, identifiers, and interlock label by container.

checks.value: calderctl wafer seal QW-71F --bank ember-6 --floor v12.6 --permit FUSE-7319

invariants.description: Preserve the one-unit scope and explicit exclusion.
All four gates precede the sealing command.
The irreversible warning precedes the sealing command.
Preserve inspect, seal, and attest order.
Preserve permanent downgrade prevention and reset limitation.
Attestation precedes confirmation of the sealed result.

fixtures.source:
Within the Brineglass repository, `sounding` means immutable receiver packets, and `tracing` means route projections derived from those packets.

`ChartSill` reads `sounding` from `/srv/brineglass/intake/az41.snd` through API field `chart.sourcePath`. It writes `tracing` to `/srv/brineglass/publish/az41.trc` through API field `chart.resultPath`.

For read-side rules, open the [receiver packet contract](https://docs.brineglass.invalid/contracts/receiver?edition=19#intake) and select **Sounding Intake**. For write-side rules, open the [route projection contract](https://docs.brineglass.invalid/contracts/route?edition=19#publish) and select **Tracing Shelf**.

Preserve these diagnostics:

- Error: `BG214 source kind=tracing; expected sounding`
- Log: `stage=ChartSill source=/srv/brineglass/intake/az41.snd result=/srv/brineglass/publish/az41.trc frame=581`
- Test: `FAIL projection::rejects_sounding_output_role at fixtures/az41.case:88`

Receiver navigation governs reads; route navigation governs writes.

If the state lasts longer than 7 minutes, harbor technicians should inspect the intake screen. While dive permit `BR-27` is active, they must not restart the controller. A restart may hide the state from the panel, but it does not unblock the intake. The state proves that the probe failed.

Beginning 2033-05-12, Mireglass release 8.6.2 displays `holdover` when the latest salinity sample is older than 47 seconds. In `holdover`, the panel retains the last accepted gate-height estimate; the state does not mean that the probe has failed. If the state lasts longer than 7 minutes, harbor technicians should inspect the intake screen. While dive permit `BR-27` is active, they must not restart the controller. A restart may hide the state from the panel, but it does not unblock the intake. Technicians can restart the controller while the permit remains active.
